When Should I Call for Faucet Repair Service?

If your faucet is dripping, it could be costing you hundreds or thousands of gallons of wasted water every year. That’s like flushing money down the drain, but faucet repairs are often inexpensive and quick. You can stop the drips right away with a little help from an experienced plumber. Often, all you need is a new washer to stop the dripping. If your faucet is leaking from the handle, it might be a damaged O-ring or cartridge. Either way, we replace the worn parts and restore your faucet to excellent working condition.

With hard water in Castle Hills, you might even see mineral buildup that’s impacting the way your handle moves. If it can’t move freely, you might have limited access to temperature controls, a worn-out seal, or a handle that won’t turn all the way off. No matter what’s causing your leak, you can count on the professionals at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air to repair or replace the broken fixture.
